title: Nordic Spirit Tropical Mix Nic Pouches
description: Nordic Spirit Tropical Mix Nicotine Pouches offer a lively combination of exotic fruit flavours with a smooth, subtly sweet character. Notes of tropical fruit—such as Pineapple, Passionfruit or Mango—combine to create a rounded flavour that feels vibrant without being overwhelming. These soft, slim pouches fit comfortably under the lip, releasing nicotine slowly and discreetly with no smoke, vapour or lingering odour. Available in Regular (6mg) and Strong (9mg) strengths, Tropical Mix offers a convenient, flavour-forward pouch that stays engaging from start to finish—ideal for users who enjoy a mellow yet fruity nicotine experience. How to Use: Place one Nordic Spirit pouch under your upper lip and allow the nicotine to release over time for a steady, satisfying experience. The pouch is designed to dissolve slowly for up to 40 minutes, providing an effective nicotine release without smoke or odour. Dispose of the pouch responsibly after use. Please Note: Do not chew, Suck or Swallow the pouches.
